name: dealer-email-flows
description: Build comprehensive lifecycle email flows for a car dealership covering the full customer relationship from purchase through year 5+. 17 dealer-specific flows: service reminder, declined recovery, lapsed-service revival, anniversary, win-back, service appointment confirmation, post-service NPS, recall outreach, quote follow-up, delivery welcome, lease maturity, equity check-in, birthday, OEM event invite, holiday, referral, test-drive follow-up. No abandoned-cart pattern (not relevant for dealer retail). Compliance guardrails inherited from dealer-equity-mining-campaign-builder. Pairs with dealer-new-customer-onboarding (handles first 90 days) and dealer-equity-mining-campaign-builder (handles time-bound upgrade campaigns).
